They noticed a friend in their area had their company jump to page one of Google after partnering with Meridian Local, so why would that not work with them, too? Affordable Tree & Shrub Experts reached out to Meridian Local to see how we could help them do the same.

Affordable Tree & Shrub Experts, along with the marketing experts at Meridian Local, came up with a marketing plan. This included:
